title: Heavenly Days Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Every day is a "heavenly" one at this beautiful Seaside cottage! Located only 4 houses up from the beach, Heavenly Days is a bright and colorful 4 BR/4 BA cottage offering the very best in Seaside vacationing. Heavenly Days is the epitome of Seaside.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 4 houses from the Private Seaside beach access at ODESSA street in Seaside - You will have a total of 8 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - 2 Adult sized beach cruisers - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Renovated, designer bathrooms - Walking/biking distance to Seaside beaches, shops, playgrounds, and restaurants - Spacious outdoor patio with sitting area - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $112/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). Every day is a "heavenly" one at this beautiful Seaside cottage! Located only 4 houses up from the beach, Heavenly Days is a bright and colorful 4 BR/4 BA cottage offering the very best in Seaside vacationing. Heavenly Days is the epitome of Seaside with its bright yellow and blue exterior decor, white picket fence, and oversized porch flanked with rocking chairs perfect for watching the quaint town bustle by. The inside of Heavenly Days exudes the same bright decor showcasing open living and dining spaces. The living room offers plenty of seating for the whole family, a flat screen TV, and dining area just off the kitchen. You'll enjoy some of the best views around from Heavenly Days' tower. Being only 4 houses back from the beach, you can even see the ocean! Whether you're watching the sun set from the tower or rocking on the front porch while you enjoy your morning coffee, Heavenly Days has something for everyone to enjoy! Accommodations: (sleeps 8) Main Floor: Bedroom 1: Master suite- King bed, en suite bathroom Bedroom 2: 2 Twin beds, en suite bathroom FULL bath in hallway (shower only) Living area with TV, kitchen and dining room Second Floor: Bedroom 3: King bed, sitting area and private balcony, TV Bedroom 4: Queen bed Shared hallway bathroom (tub/shower) ADDITIONAL DETAILS ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $112/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. ** No pets allowed FREE WiFi

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
